description: AUDIT Tier 1 (softlock): a pending Moment Shackle choice used to hang an AI player forever — FightPhase.get_available_actions short-circuits to USE/DECLINE_MOMENT_SHACKLE only, and AIDecisionMaker had no branch for it, so the empty decision looped on the watchdog without ever counting toward MAX_ACTIONS_PER_PHASE. This drives the fixed path: the active player's unit is given the ability and queued, the player is flipped to AI, and within a few watchdog cycles the AI must resolve the window (use or decline — both are progress) with no dialog spawned and the pending queue drained.
